text: The UI Designer will group the functions into two groups: display functions and basic functions.
The UI Designer will compile a list of the functions to be on the LCD screen menu.
The current look-and-feel and usability of remote controls are disliked by users and are hard to learn, with remotes often getting lost in rooms.

The project targets users aged sixteen to forty, removes teletext (for TV), keeps all classic remote functions with improved usability and physical design, enforces corporate identity with logo and colours, and splits functions into simple and advanced groups.
